    php:    wrapper_type=PHP   stream_type=STDIO  uri=php://filter/read=.../resource=<path>

The `uri` and the `stream_type` were already right; only the wrapper id was not. The LITERAL form
is re-stamped at its open site by a parser that never sees a computed path, so the inner opener's
identity — plainfile — stayed on the handle.
